description:
Take control of your closet with Repelure's advanced Clothing Moth Traps, designed to strategically target and capture adult male Casemaking and Webbing moths. Our moth traps employ the industry’s strongest pheromone lure to mimic the scent of a female moth, attracting male moths and trapping them with our industrial-grade glue. This targeted approach helps break the moth breeding cycle, creating a long-term solution to moth infestations. Mothballs altenative

FEATURES & BENEFITS:

Clothing Moth Traps

Stickiest Glue Hold
Easy to Use
Convenient Hanging Hook
Fits Easily Inside Closets
Freshness-Sealed Packaging
Safe for Indoor Use
Safe for Children and Pets
6 Month Extended Protection

YOUR CASTLE WAS BREACHED.
Declare your sovereignty with 6 easy steps:

1. IDENTIFY THE MOTHS
Repelure clothing moth traps are intended for male Casemaking and Webbing moths when they are in their adult stage. Our clothing moth traps are not effective for gypsy, food, or other moths.

2. CLEAN THE AFFECTED AREA
Get rid of the larvae before they do more damage to your clothes. Thoroughly clean the affected area with soapy water. Wash your clothing or materials on the hottest cycle that the fabric allows. Dry clean if applicable.

3. OPEN THE TRAPS
Carefully open the packaging, and remove the protective sheet to expose the pheromone and glue.

4. SET THE TRAPS
Fold the traps carefully and ensure the sides do not stick together.

5. PLACE TRAPS STRATEGICALLY
Place 2-3 traps in your closet space, depending on closet size. For best results, place traps on opposite sides of the closet. Do not crowd the closet, and do not place them close to each other. Hang them at different heights to increase effectiveness.

6. WAIT
Allow 14 days for pheromones to unleash their power. You may still see some female or juvenile moths around. Those will usually disappear after a while due to a disrupted breeding cycle, but can be treated separately.
